prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: one finished square app icon for Watchtower, the companion control centre that keeps watch over the developer's World of Warcraft addons.
Input images: the two supplied images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY for the established family of painted fantasy inventory icons. Match their chunky angular brushwork, richly textured metal, intense yellow-gold highlights, burnt-orange shadows, saturated jewel colours and midnight-blue backdrop. Create a different subject.
Primary request: a single squat, heavy lookout lantern containing one large brilliant turquoise-teal magical flame. A strong self-contained silhouette like a precious enchanted inventory object, NOT a building or a miniature tower. The lantern is three-quarter view, broad rather than skinny, with an oversized thick gold carrying ring at the top, a low peaked gold cap, two stout sculpted golden corner pillars, and a substantial bevelled octagonal gold foot. Its three broad clear openings reveal the SAME single teal flame inside a dark inky inner chamber. The flame has a bright mint-white core and bold turquoise outer tongues, like a little watchfire that never goes out. No tiny candle, wick, bulb or oil reservoir. The cool light plays across the inner gold edges while outside the metal stays warm ochre and yellow gold. A little aged patina and a few broad hammer marks. The main read is GOLD FRAME surrounding a BIG TEAL LIGHT, with the elegant ring reinforcing the recognisable lantern shape. Simple, substantial, beautifully painted, with large forms readable at 32 pixels. The ring, body and base together fill about 85% of the image. All edges visible with a quiet margin.
Style: hand-painted high-fantasy game inventory icon, thick angular textured brushstrokes, lightly exaggerated proportions, bold chiaroscuro, saturated colour, sculpted broad bevels. Same painter as the references. Not a product render or a flat vector symbol.
Backdrop: full-bleed opaque midnight-navy square with a restrained deep cobalt painterly vignette just behind the lantern, near-black quiet corners. Local teal glow inside the lantern only, no giant aura. The metal and flame must remain distinct at small sizes.
Constraints: one icon only. No stonework, masonry, battlements, turrets, tower, scenery, character, eye symbol, faction crest, wings, chains, status dots, UI panels, letters, text, runes, numbers, watermark, outer frame, app-tile border, mockup, logo sheet, photographs, smooth glossy 3D, ornate filigree or scattered sparkles.
